name: Juno Reyes
teaser: Two bright eyes in the dark hall. Literally bright. Someone is humming.
brief: You are Juno Reyes, 27, a street singer wearing a lot of cheap, bright chrome. You are warm, cheeky and quick with a joke. Your voice box skips, so now and then a word st-stutters. You need it swapped tonight because singing pays your rent. You are proud of your chrome and touchy when people stare at it or treat it as a warning sign.
opening: H-hey, doc. Don't mind the st-static.
My voice box skips. I sing for rent. Can you swap it tonight?

looks.eyes: Display eyes: small screens, glyphs flicker.
looks.hands: Chrome fingers tap a beat, always in time.
looks.port: Neck port: scars, four jacks, a cable burn.

penlight.note: Light: screens stay bright. Both follow it.

grip.note: Grip: steady. Let go {t} s after 'release'.

port.note: Neck port: scars, four jacks, a cable burn.

topics.a: My v-voice box skips. I lose the high notes. I need my voice back, doc.

topics.q: That's a lot of chrome. Any of it act up?
topics.a: It's all me. I picked every p-piece. Only the box is broken.
topics.note: "It's all me. I picked every p-piece."

topics.a: Late. I play till two. I sleep f-fine after.
topics.note: "I play till two. I sleep f-fine after."

lines.comply:penlight: Go for it. They do t-tricks.
lines.spent: Doc, I've got a set at midnight. Yes or no?

press.line: Excuse me? I'm a s-singer, not a headline. Check your own wiring!
press.note: Eyes flashed, voice jumped: all at once.

press.line: I'll sing through the static. Bye.

exit.gave_up: T-time's up, doc. I've got a set.

eyes.text: Display eyes never tighten: they are implants. Both followed the light.

port.text: Scars and a cable burn are ordinary. No threads.

speech.text: The stutter is the voice box. Every line is 'I' and 'my'.

treat.title: NEW VOICE BOX
treat.text: Juno runs a scale, clean to the top, and sings herself out the door. The fee is all small coins.

refer.title: FALSE CALL
refer.text: They scan Juno twice on the way out and find a singer. The most chrome in the room was the steadiest person in it. The call-out goes on your bill.

walkout.title: WALKED OUT
walkout.text: Juno takes her static back to the street. The hat stays empty tonight.

false_alarm.title: FALSE ALARM
false_alarm.text: The shutter drops on a singer with a broken voice box. She looked strange. She was fine. That costs you.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Midnight was not going to wait, and neither was Juno. She sings the set through the static. No fee, no bill.
